purpose: Skeleton-first lower-limb long-bone audit. Distinguish retained plausible long-bone geometry from regions that need reconstruction.

patella.reading: A003 patellar pole-to-pole length lies comfortably between two independent adult male reference sets. Size alone is not a reason to rebuild the patella.

fibula.reading: The a003 fibular control span is plausible for a tall male, but the osteometric proxy is near/above the upper region of these samples. Endpoint semantics and stature conditioning must be reconciled before freezing exact length.

lower_limb_subject_crosscheck.note: A 183 cm male SSM example has femur 428.3 mm and tibia/fibula segment 441.6 mm; a 180 cm male has femur 418.4 mm and tibia/fibula 425.5 mm. These model-specific segment definitions are broadly compatible with the current joint-centre lower-limb spans and do not indicate the dramatic proportional defects seen in the shoulder, spine, hand or foot.

findings: The lower-limb long-bone chain is not showing the same gross proportion failure as the shoulder girdle, lumbar spine or forefoot.
Patellar size is provisionally plausible: the current ~44 mm length is within independent adult male MRI/dry-bone corridors.
Femur and tibia joint-centre locations were already independently corroborated, so they should remain provisional anchors while the pelvis and foot are rebuilt.
Fibula geometry still needs endpoint-defined verification and proximal/distal contact refinement, but there is no evidence to justify a blanket lengthening or shortening now.
The patella still needs a true trochlear translation/contact path; a plausible bone size does not solve patellofemoral kinematics.
acceptance_tests: Femur and tibia centres remain compatible with retained HJC/KJC/ankle evidence.
Fibular head and lateral malleolus endpoints are checked against an endpoint-matched male source and preserve proximal/distal tibiofibular contacts.
Patella length/width/thickness and ridge orientation remain within adult male corridors.
Patellar translation through the trochlea is source-backed before Gate 8/9 pass.
Lower-limb mechanics are rerun after pelvis and foot canonical retargeting.
